_excerpt_of: configs/validators.json (entries used by the scene; receptor_rmsd and binding_reaction_coordinate are new)

receptor_rmsd.name: Receptor RMSD vs Reference
receptor_rmsd.description: Root-mean-square deviation of restrained particles from their reference (crystal) coordinates must stay bounded
receptor_rmsd.physics_note: The canonical MD structural-stability metric: RMSD = sqrt(mean |r_i - r_i(ref)|^2) over restrained particles. For a position-restrained structure the expected plateau is the thermal fluctuation amplitude (coarse analog of crystallographic B-factors); unbounded growth means the fold is degrading. Tolerance 0.8 sigma = ~2x the measured plateau of the restrained lysozyme C-alpha trace (~0.4 sigma).

binding_reaction_coordinate.name: Binding Reaction Coordinate
binding_reaction_coordinate.description: Distance between ligand center of mass and binding-site centroid must reach the bound basin
binding_reaction_coordinate.physics_note: The reaction coordinate of a binding event: |COM(ligand) - centroid(site residues)|. Calibrated against the 1SFB crystallographic pose: penta-NAG's crystal pose (spanning sub-sites A-E exactly) measures 2.07 sigma from the site-lining C-alpha centroid, so tolerance 2.9 = crystal value + 0.8 sigma thermal margin - the validator certifies the ligand re-entered the crystallographic bound basin. Unbound approach starts at ~8 sigma. Reads as FAIL during approach by construction and flips to PASS at the rebinding event - an outcome validator in the same spirit as rutherford_scattering_angle.

energy_stability.name: Energy Stability
energy_stability.description: Total energy should not drift catastrophically (symplectic integrator)
energy_stability.physics_note: KNOWN LIMITATION: Relativistic symplectic Euler does NOT conserve the relativistic Hamiltonian H=√(p²+m²)+V. Energy drift is expected for: (1) highly relativistic particles (v→c), (2) strong forces (nuclear scales), (3) extreme mass ratios (electron/proton). Tolerance of 100% catches catastrophic instabilities while accepting expected integrator limitations. For strict energy conservation, use non-relativistic scenes or implement Boris pusher.

momentum_conservation.name: Momentum Conservation
momentum_conservation.description: Total momentum must remain constant (Newton's third law)
momentum_conservation.physics_note: Σp_initial = Σp_final for isolated systems. Tolerance of 50 MeV·fm/c accounts for: (1) relativistic symplectic Euler integration drift, (2) extreme mass ratios (electron/proton ~1800:1), (3) long-running simulations (10k+ steps). Violations >>50 indicate real physics bugs, not numerical error.

charge_conservation.name: Charge Conservation
charge_conservation.description: Total electric charge must remain constant
charge_conservation.physics_note: Charge is absolutely conserved in all known processes

subluminal_velocity.name: Velocity < c
subluminal_velocity.description: All particle velocities must be below speed of light
subluminal_velocity.physics_note: Special relativity: v < c always. Cheap check - run frequently to catch violations early.
